decision.article_title: Clueso Bags $10 Mn To Automate Enterprise Video Creation With AI Agents - Inc42
decision.reason: Inc42 full report documents enterprise tutorial/product video update work after feature, process and brand changes. A manual video inventory/release change-impact register, separate from model-based AI creation, is a plausible workflow hypothesis pending competition tests.

opportunities.core_job: Identify which customer education/tutorial videos are stale following product feature, branding or process changes, and approve revised deliverables
opportunities.target_customer: B2B SaaS customer education, product marketing and enablement content operators
opportunities.product_mechanism: Product/feature release log CSV → video lesson dependency map → impacted scenes/owners/priority → human update checklist → publication evidence and version closure
opportunities.why_now: Inc42 Oct13 Clueso funding article explicitly describes enterprise customers' repeating need to keep hundreds of videos up to date as product features/process/brand guidelines change
opportunities.before_state: Product release owners inform video editors through ad-hoc emails without systematic inventory-to-feature trace
opportunities.after_state: Deterministic stale-video inventory and signed editing acceptance; creation/editing of video remains external and manual
